Closes #2500

This fixes three of the four red jobs of super run 41068815706 (`fuzz (3/4)` in part). Seed 5548's growth breach in `fuzz (3/4)` is left open for a person to decide.

## What changed

- **`crates/cards/src/scripts/classic/c088_siphon_squad.rs`: Siphon Squad's Tribute loop (R2500000).**
  - **Cause:** Siphon Squad's "When your opponent has no Units, Tribute this", fused with S #112 Job Application's "Death: Resummon this at Stage 1" and with the opponent holding no Units, Tributed the Unit at every state check. The Death brought it straight back, so the board never settled ("board did not settle in 100 passes").
  - **Seeds:** plain seed 7243 (`[play]`) and Duos seed 1231 hit it. M #47 饕餮's end-of-turn fusing built the Unit in each case.
  - **Fix:** `tribute_when` now holds nothing on a body that isn't Siphon Squad itself and arrived this turn. This mirrors R2197005's terminator for Floodgates' sweep. A printed Siphon Squad is still Tributed the moment it is set. The v0.3.7b script is unchanged, because R767000 keeps it for replays.
  - **Tests and spec:** three tests, `r2500000_*`. The two that exercise the loop fail without the fix with the "did not settle" panic. The new ruling note is `spec/rulings/R2500000.md`, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/2500.md`.
  - **Rejected:** ending the loop in Job Application's Death. That breaks `r2197005_a_resummon_before_the_sweep_ends`.
- **`e2e/cypress/e2e/20-mulligan-concede-draw.cy.ts` (e2e 3/8).**
  - **Cause:** in "R266 the browser answers first", R82's auto-end ended turn 1 on this seed's hand, so `data-turn` was 2 instead of 1.
  - **Fix:** the spec now opens with `autoEndTurn:false` (R345).
- **`e2e/support/config.ts` (e2e 5/8, spec 23).** `TUTORIAL_HANDICAP` lacked `coreOnly: true`, which the engine's `AI_TUTORIAL` has had since #2448/R2433000.
- **`e2e/cypress/e2e/22-tutorial-lesson-one.cy.ts` (e2e 6/8).** The expected AI handicap lacked `poolHold: true` (R2434001). Spec 23 already has it.

## How it was checked

All commands below were run on this branch with release binaries:
- **Fuzz:** shard 3 of 4, plain seeds 5001..7500, passed 2500/2500 once the Siphon fix and the (since reverted) bound change were both in. Seed 5548 passes only with that bound change, so it fails again now that the change is reverted. The Duos run, seeds 1001..1500, passed 500/500 and 1231 passes alone. The handicap run, 5001..7500, had one failure, seed 6221 ("checkpoint took 8600ms") — see below.
- **Seed 6221:** it failed once while my own builds were saturating the CPU. It passes alone at about 550 ms, three times, and the earlier clean full wave passed too (slowest 1345 ms). I treated that as a load artifact and made no change.
- **E2E:** shards 3/8, 5/8 and 6/8 are green locally. Spec 40 passes only when `target/release/jackioh` exists, which is a local environment need.
- **Static checks:** `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` on the tools and cards crates, and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass. `cargo test -p jackioh-cards -p jackioh-tools` was run earlier in the branch. After this pass's revert of `fuzz.rs` to `main` I re-ran only `fmt` and `spec check`.

## Review findings

1. **Raising `GROWTH_NUMBER_BOUND` and `DUOS_GROWTH_NUMBER_BOUND` to 32,768 held, so I reverted it.**
   - The Radiant face repeats the doubling 17 times (about 524k), so 32,768 is only three more doublings. The same edit also stops the check catching Joint Filing's runaway at step 104.
   - **Seed 5548 is not fixed.** It is a rules-exact chain: Echo X × Unsecure System doubles a 4-Attack Mr. Vanilla (traininggrounds-043) nine times, up to 2,044. That is above the 2,000 bound, and no rule caps Attack.
   - **Decision for a person:** either cap Attack or exempt board stats from the number bound, or give the bound a different rule. Stats (attack, health, damage) are the only numbers a rule legitimately compounds. Counters, tuned numbers and memory would keep the 2,000 bound that catches Joint Filing and R884000's University.
   - `fuzz (3/4)` will stay red on seed 5548 until then. The run's issue stays open, because the next passing run closes it.
2. **The R2500000 wording finding held, so I fixed the note.** The note said the guard lasts until the controller's next turn. The code compares `summoned_turn` with `state.turn`, which advances every turn, so the guard ends at the next turn of either player. If the opponent still has no Units then, the Unit is Tributed and returns again. The note now says this, and it agrees with the card header's "returns once a turn".

## Other things to know

- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test export_card_text` fails on `main`: `chinese.json` is out of line with `card-text.yaml` generation. Regenerating it would revert #2415's timing wording, so I did not touch it.
- `jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` was not run here because it needs a parent binary build.
- Nothing in `.github/` needs to change.

### Adversarial review

Approved on round 2 of 3.
